tgt_text: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir juu ya maendeleo ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jumuiya mwezi huu wa Oktoba.

src_text: Council of Governors updates residents of Murang'a County on progress of the county integrated development plan this May.
tgt_text: Baraza la Gavana linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti hii Mei.

src_text: ODPP urges residents of Samburu County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
tgt_text: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kuwasiliana na msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja ya kaunti.

src_text: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) launches community-based development programmes in Siaya County.
tgt_text: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inazindua mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii katika Kaunti ya Siaya.

src_text: EACC reminds residents of Kwale County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
tgt_text: EACC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale ambao huhudhuria mkutano wa umma wa mkutano wa kaunti huimarisha utawala wa mitaa.

src_text: E-Citizen urges residents of Kajiado County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
tgt_text: E-Citizen inahimiza wakazi wa Kajiado County kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili kuwajulisha juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika kiwango cha wilaya.

src_text: Notice: ODPP launches the county integrated development plan in Tana River County.
tgt_text: Taarifa: ODPP inazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika Wilaya ya Tana River.

src_text: IEBC updates residents of Vihiga County on progress of county development projects this October.
tgt_text: IEBC inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga juu ya maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti hii Oktoba.

src_text: Notice: KRA launches county development projects in Laikipia County.
tgt_text: Taarifa: KRA inazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.

src_text: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) updates residents of Siaya County on progress of the county integrated development plan this November.
tgt_text: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja ya kaunti hii mwezi Novemba.
